in_sanskrit.name: Ashank
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ashwin's descendant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashank एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the name Ashwin, meaning horse or the invincible. In Hindu mythology, Ashank is considered a descendant of the Ashwin twins, the divine physicians and horse-riding gods. It is believed that this name brings good fortune, courage, and strength.
